Dans le cas des cérémonies d'adieu organisées pour les Adeptes, Hu Tao fait appel à l'un de ses collègues, Zhongli. La présence des Adeptes à…

chapters.title: Histoire du personnage 1
chapters.text: À Liyue, si une personne accorde une grande attention aux détails et a des critères insurmontables par lesquels elle juge certaines choses, alors elle est appelée « particulière ». En vérité, tout le monde est « particulier » à propos de quelque chose. Certains détestent la nourriture épicée, d'autres ne mangent pas de poisson, et certains veulent que leur tofu soit servi sucré... Mais Zhongli, il est particulier pour tout. Il doit assister aux opéras des artistes les…

chapters.title: Histoire du personnage 2
chapters.text: Lorsque vous achetez quelque chose à Liyue, il faut toujours négocier. C'est la règle. Quelle que soit la valeur que le propriétaire donne à son produit, ou son histoire, les prix sont toujours flexibles. Considérez la moitié du prix indiqué comme étant un bon point de départ pour les négociations. Mais lorsque Zhongli achète quelque chose (ou plutôt demande à quelqu'un de l'acheter pour lui), il ne regarde jamais à la dépense. Tant que l'objet lui plaît, Zhongli…

chapters.title: Histoire du personnage 3
chapters.text: Mourir de faim ? Inconcevable pour Zhongli. Perdre ou gagner de l'argent n'a guère d'importance pour lui. Son cœur est dévoué aux Sept Nations. Et pour ce qui est des finances... Zhongli en est l'incarnation. Eh oui ! Il est le Souverain de la Roche, l'Archon Géo, le dirigeant de Liyue, alias Morax. C'est son nom que porte la monnaie qui circule en Teyvat. Lorsque la nuit tombe, et que Liyue, grouillante de vie, s'endort, parfois l'Archon monte…

chapters.title: Histoire du personnage 4
chapters.text: En tant que fondateur du Port de Liyue, Morax accorde une importance particulière à la notion de « contrat ». Du simple accord commercial entre marchands à l'ancien code de lois qu'il a lui-même rédigé, il n'y a pas un aspect de la vie de la ville qui ne soit régi par des contrats. Pour les commerçants, ils sont la garantie d'une transaction équitable et sûre, que ce soit pour les délais, les factures, les destinations d'expédition... Ce…

chapters.title: Histoire du personnage 5
chapters.text: En tant qu'aîné des Sept, le Souverain de la Roche a vécu longtemps. Il se souvient encore de l'époque où la guerre des Archons prit fin et où les sept derniers Archons prirent chacun leurs trônes respectifs en tant que « dieux ». Bien qu'ils étaient parfois en désaccord et résidaient à des milliers de kilomètres les uns des autres, ils avaient tous le devoir de guider les humains. Au fil du temps, de nombreux titres des Sept…

chapters.title: Fruits de mer
chapters.text: Pendant la Guerre des Archons, Teyvat toute entière brûlait des flammes du conflit. Non seulement les dieux se battaient entre eux, mais d'innombrables créatures maléfiques essayaient également d'étendre leur territoire. Une de ces créatures causa beaucoup de difficulté à l'Archon Géo, qui n'avait pas encore établi sa couronne. Ces créatures jaillissaient de l'abîme océanique, avaient un extérieur spongieux et possédaient des tentacules agiles qui repoussaient après avoir été coupées, sécrétant même un fluide trouble dans le processus. Elles…

chapters.title: Œil divin
chapters.text: Une fois que le rituel de l'ascension, dont Zhongli était à la fois directeur et interprète, fut terminé, l'Exécutrice Fatui nommée Signora apparut devant lui. Selon un accord déjà négocié, elle était là pour obtenir le Gnosis de l'Archon Géo Morax. Zhongli avoua qu'il avait établi un contrat avec l'Archon Cryo. De ses propres mots, c'était « le contrat mettant fin à tous les contrats ». Pourtant, peu importe comment on le regarde, la perte de ses pouvoirs…

chapters.title: Character Details
chapters.text: The legends of Liyue make mention of a mysterious White Horse Adeptus. Traces of her story are scattered throughout books and folktales. Yet, across these diverse sources, accounts of her appearance are never quite the same. Some say she became a steed as white as snow and, in the days of the Archon War , aided Rex Lapis in attaining supremacy over the mortal realm. Others whisper that her eyes, like amber touched with gold, hold the power…

chapters.title: Character Story 1
chapters.text: Few realize that the legends told of the White Horse Adeptus across Liyue were born from her demise. She was an envoy from the heavens who descended, millennia ago, to guide the journey of mortals. She watched over the ancient kingdom of Lang-Gan , a realm of Sand Crystals and gemstones. It was she who taught the people of the kingdom to till and to weave, and, as a result, they prospered with bountiful harvests, their granaries close…

chapters.title: Character Story 2
chapters.text: In a time long past, when Zibai descended upon the mortal world as an envoy of the moons , she befriended a being most unusual. Though he bore the semblance of a mortal man — one with a striking visage — he could ride the clouds and mist, move mountains and fill seas, shatter rocks, and grind jade to dust. Yet despite possessing powers that could rival the divine, he was not of the angelic race — much…

chapters.title: Character Story 3
chapters.text: In the void moon, where time stands still, all things appear to have ceased their flow. But time does not truly stop — it merely slows to the point of imperceptibility. A single day in the mortal world feels as though a century is passing here. ...One hundred and fifty-one... One hundred and fifty-seven... One hundred and sixty-seven... Indeed, time must slowly pass — how else could one explain the erasure of the memories once engraved in my…

chapters.title: Character Story 4
chapters.text: The White Horse Adeptus who frequently appears in Liyue's legends is Zijiao, the Third Deadly Self severed by Zibai. She was the "White Horse" that the elder of Qingce Village said "would assist the campaigns of the Lord of Geo." She was the "Daughter of Time" known to the clans of Chenyu Vale. She was the "Gold-Eyed Celadon Mare" referenced in The Sanctification of Tao Dou . She was even the White Horse Adeptus who "leapt across the…

chapters.title: Character Story 5
chapters.text: Much like the unforeseen catastrophe that befell the land she loved, the turning point that altered Zibai's fate once more arrived from beyond the heavens. Thanks to the efforts of the golden-haired traveler and (‍ his Text for male Traveler ‍/ ‍ her Text for female Traveler ‍) companions, the true moon returned to the skies of Teyvat , while the false moon that had imprisoned Zibai's essence began to crumble. With the aid of another old friend,…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Alice , also known by her codename "A," is a famous adventurer who is also the author of Teyvat Travel Guide , the founder of the Hexenzirkel , [ 7 ] and the mother of Klee . She is a polymath whose skills include alchemy , astrology, engineering, magic, and medicine. She regularly made cameos, primarily in summer events, up until her physical form was revealed in the Nod-Krai Preview Teaser - "Prelude to Moonlight" . She makes…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: As well-versed in astrology as she was, my master knew only astrology. Alice, on the other hand, was skilled in a great many other mystical fields. Alice is an adventurer who belongs to a long-lived elven race and is at least 500 years old herself. She has allegedly seen the entire world and possibly even beyond , based on the description of Wings of Feasting , her reference to the Rubicon , [ 8 ] and her narration…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Alice appears in a multitude of outfits and forms, debuting and communicating through both an inanimate phonograph and teacup set on several occasions. She then makes an appearance in the form of a Dodoco , designed in her likeness with a red hue covering its tail and wearing a distinct red, black and gold witch hat. In her illustrated physical form, she is first seen wearing a large, wide-brimmed witch hat adorned with a bow. She has long…

chapters.title: History
chapters.text: Alice met Nicole when she was still a child, known as the "little merry-witch." After listening to Nicole's stories, Alice invited her to join a newly formed group she had just come up with, the Hexenzirkel , effectively making Nicole one of its earliest members. At the time, Alice enthusiastically described it as a club that would become the "funniest, awesomest, best" in all of Teyvat. At an unknown point later in the past, Alice also became acquainted…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Il Dottore , also known as " The Doctor " and by his personal name Zandik , was the Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers . Born in Sumeru over 400 years ago, Dottore studied at the Sumeru Akademiya , but was expelled for pursuing unauthorized, heretical, and unethical research and experiments. He was later recruited to become a Fatui Harbinger by Pierro in exchange for resources to continue his research. Driven by the ambition to elevate humanity…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Dottore's unfettered research towards creating a god , or elevating humans to the level of gods, left him ostracized from mainstream society but paved the way for him to become the Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, [ 9 ] [ 10 ] with power comparable to the gods'. [ 11 ] No subject is off-limits to him. He has researched Khaenri'ah 's Automatons, researched ways to weaponize forbidden knowledge (via The Withering and Eleazar ), and sought…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Due to the existence of multiple segments at varying ages, Dottore has a larger number of unique physical appearances compared to other characters. Zandik and his segments all share the traits of wavy, light-blue hair, average or above-average height (barring his one child segment), red eyes, and a slender build. During his time at Sumeru Akademiya, Sohreh described him as "young" and "handsome." [ 20 ] His in-game model, introduced as the Omega Build, is based on his…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Dainsleif , sometimes shortened to Dain , is an upcoming playable character in Genshin Impact . He is the featured character for Chapter ?? of the Teyvat Chapter Storyline , which focuses on the lost kingdom of Khaenri'ah , as well as the narrator of the Collected Miscellany videos. He makes his first in-game appearance in the World Quest Bough Keeper: Dainsleif in Chapter I : Act IV - Prelude. Dainsleif is the former knight captain of the…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Il Capitano , also known as " The Captain " and by his personal name Thrain , is the First of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers . He is a man from Khaenri'ah who served as a high ranking knight and Commander until the fall of the kingdom during the Cataclysm 500 years ago, after which he was placed under a curse of immortality by Ronova . Sometime afterwards, he joined the Fatui in Snezhnaya as a Harbinger, becoming…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Capitano, also known as "The Captain," [ 5 ] enjoys a high reputation amongst the Fatui for his strength, skill as a commander, and moral integrity. Lower-ranked members refer to him as "the ever-righteous Captain" and "the nigh-invincible Captain," [ 6 ] with some stating that they would prefer to work under him, if they had the choice. [ 7 ] The elite soldiers under Capitano's command, much like himself, also hold themselves to firm moral standards. […

chapters.title: Personality
chapters.text: Capitano is a individual with high-moral standards, having strong sense of honor and righteousness, as he stated that he shouldn't be praised for the fight against Mavuika since he lost, plain and simple. It shows his humbleness, refusing to take credit for something he failed. [ 16 ] He is admired as "the brave and fearless Captain", and demonstrates unwavering loyalty to Anastasya , a calm demeanor, and is respected even by enemies like Varka, often prioritizing honor…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Capitano is a tall man with a rather large build. He has glowing, dark blue eyes [ 20 ] and long black hair that protrudes from the back of his helmet and over his shoulders. His helmet obscures his face, which he mentions is in a state of "decay" and disfigurement. [ 13 ] While Capitano reveals his face to a surprised Traveler and Paimon to show the suffering that the Ruler of Death inflicted on both himself…

chapters.title: Story
chapters.text: Thrain was born in Khaenri'ah, where he served as a high ranking knight and Commander, eventually being honored with the title of Sentinel Knight. [ 19 ] Thrain's heart was also modified with Khaenri'ahn tecnology to convert memories and souls into knowledge from the Ley Lines. [ 19 ] He was distantly acquainted with the Traveler's sibling , whom he saw for the last time together with Dainsleif . [ 13 ] When the cataclysm hit Khaenri'ah, Thrain…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Ronova was the Ruler of Death among the Four Shades and the Arbiter of the Heavenly Principles . She was one of the four gods created by the Heavenly Principles when they first arrived on Teyvat thousands of years ago. After the conclusion of the war of funerary flame 6,000 years ago, she instructed Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night , to create the Night Kingdom in order to repair Natlan 's Ley Lines that had been destroyed during…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Death renders all things equal. A remedy bestowed upon one long wearied by illness, or the clear sky unveiled when the clouds at last disperse — such are the metaphors for death. As the Ruler of Death, Ronova governed over the laws of death in Teyvat . She had the power to freely define the form of death for any entity in Teyvat, even deny it altogether, such as when she cast the curse of immortality on the…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Ronova's personal form was that of a tall, curvaceous woman with pale skin, long and thick white hair and golden eyes with 7 petals flower-shaped pupils. Eye motifs could be seen within the folds of her hair at the top of her head as well as on her eyelashes at the outer corners of her eyes. Her arms were an almost black color with red eye-like patterns marked across them. Her nails appeared to elongate when she focused…

chapters.title: History
chapters.text: In the time period known as "When the Doves Held Branches," the Heavenly Principles descended upon the world of Teyvat from the sea of stars . They battled against the Seven Sovereigns and, to that end, created Four Shades of themself, one of which was Ronova. According to extant sources, forty years after the Heavenly Principles' initial appearance, the Seven Sovereigns were ultimately defeated, and the seven great nations of the realm capitulated to their dominion. [ 5…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Paimon is the deuteragonist of Genshin Impact . She is a quest-exclusive NPC who accompanies the Traveler throughout their adventure in Teyvat as their guide. She met the Traveler when the latter fished her out of the sea, after which she mentions she would have drowned if not saved by the Traveler. [ 10 ] She currently represents Genshin Impact as its mascot and is used as the icon for the game, its official website, and various social…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Despite her omnipresence in the story, marketing, and player communication, Paimon is something of an enigma with regard to the plot and Teyvat. Nothing is known about her life between the Cataclysm and prior to meeting the Traveler, nor what she was doing or what she was like prior to her arrival in Khaenri'ah , [ 5 ] and even her basic nature is still unclear. It seems that even Paimon herself does not remember these details; she…

chapters.title: Personality
chapters.text: Paimon has a bubbly, outgoing, honest, and somewhat naïve demeanor. As a result, she occasionally comes across as blunt and rude. She is obvious about who she likes and dislikes, often giving "ugly nicknames" to those who annoy her, such as calling Venti the "Tone-Deaf Bard" and Arataki Itto as "Bull Chucker" (although she currently uses these as playful banter). Despite her small stature and sassy nature, Paimon cares for and comforts the people around her, occasionally acting…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Paimon is a petite, bipedal humanoid with a short stature. She has thick, shoulder-length white hair with soft curls at the ends. Her eyes are dark purple with bright white pupils, and she has light skin. In several promotional artworks, one of the strands of hair on the left side of her head fades to black. She wears a white long-sleeved jumper adorned with rose-gold designs and trims, including a triquetra symbol on the chest. Her sleeves and…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Istaroth , also known as Kairos and Tokoyo Ookami in Enkanomiya , is the Ruler of Time among the Four Shades of the Heavenly Principles . She was one of the four gods created by the Heavenly Principles when they first arrived on Teyvat thousands of years ago. Though her existence has largely been forgotten following the war of funerary flame 6,000 years ago, she has continued influencing the world in the millennia that followed; Venti , Zibai…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: As the Ruler of Time, Istaroth governs over the laws of time in Teyvat . She is said to remember everything while allowing everything to be forgotten, [ 6 ] and considers all living beings to be equal in both value and significance. [ 7 ] She is consumed by boredom, constantly seeking ways to "pass the time." [ 8 ] She occasionally alters the course of history, often times in favor of gods and mortals. [ 9…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: As with the other Shades, Istaroth has the appearance of a tall woman with pale skin, golden eyes and long white hair that seemingly "fades away" in the tips. Her irises are similar to a clock without pointers and a part of her hair is swiped to the right side of her face with some braids decorating it. Her hands are periwinkle with golden accessories surrounding her right hand. She wears an intricately detailed short white dress that…

chapters.title: History
chapters.text: In the time period known as "When the Doves Held Branches," the Heavenly Principles descended upon the world of Teyvat from the sea of stars . They battled against the Seven Sovereigns and, to that end, created Four Shades of themself, one of which was Istaroth. 40 years after the Heavenly Principles' appearance, the Seven Sovereigns were vanquished and the seven nations submitted to their authority. Istaroth may have contributed to the new world the Heavenly Principles made.…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Pierro , also known as " The Jester " and by his personal name Eftirvit , is the Director of the Fatui and the leader of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers . Born in Khaenri'ah , he was a royal mage who worked as the Vice-President of the Universitas Magistrorum during the years before the Cataclysm 500 years ago. After the fall of the kingdom, he soon made his way to Snezhnaya and partnered himself with Anastasya , supporting…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Pierro, "The Jester," is the Director of the Fatui, [ 1 ] [ 5 ] and the very first member of the organization. He was the first person to ever become a Harbinger and currently serves as their leader. [ 6 ] He has personally recruited several Harbingers, including Il Dottore , [ 7 ] Scaramouche , [ 8 ] and Signora . [ 9 ] Pierro has an Electro Delusion , also referred to as "Eye of…

chapters.title: History
chapters.text: Pierro was born Eftirvit, a pure-blooded Khaenri'ahn in the decades prior to the Cataclysm. [ 5 ] He served the Eclipse Dynasty as a royal mage of Khaenri'ah . [ 8 ] Together with Hroptatyr , he studied at Universitas Magistrorum under Professor Mimameith , who eventually contracted a chronic illness due to research into the Abyss . The two were considered some of the top minds of their time. [ 11 ] Eftirvit became the Vice-President of…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Rhinedottir , also known by her title " Gold " and by her Hexenzirkel codename "R," is one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah , a mage of the Hexenzirkel, and the Ruler of Life among the Four Shades of the Heavenly Principles . She is a Khaenri'ahn alchemist and practitioner of the Art of Khemia who served the Eclipse Dynasty during the closing years of the kingdom. 500 years ago, Rhinedottir and the other Sinners' usage of…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Rhinedottir was an alchemist and researcher from Khaenri'ah who attained the pinnacle of both knowledge and alchemical prowess, thus coming to be known as "Gold". As one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, she is a transcendental being who possesses an "earth-shattering" amount of Abyssal power. She was particularly proficient in the forbidden Art of Khemia (the alchemical practice of creating life) and used it to create all sorts of living beings. At some point in time, she…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Rhinedottir is portrayed in several forms. Her physical appearance is that of a fair woman with light skin, golden eyelashes, and heterochromic eyes; the right eye is gray, while the left eye is yellow. The two eyes also bear two different symbols. Her blonde hair fades to an orange color and is left loose. She also has blonde eyebrows. There is one unique strand of hair on the left side that fades to a bright yellow and resembles…

chapters.title: Background
chapters.text: Rhinedottir was a proficient alchemist from Khaenri'ah with mastery over the Art of Khemia. Alongside Surtalogi, Rerir and Hroptatyr , Rhinedottir would help Dainsleif attack the Royal Palace in order to free his brother Vedrfolnir after he was punished by Irmin . She was surprised to hear the news, since she was aware of Vedrfolnir's position in the king's court, and she suspected that Dainsleif had been planning the attack for a while seeing how resolved he was…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Anastasya Feodorovna Snezhnaya ( Russian : Анастасия Фёдоровна Снежная Anastasiya Fyodorovna Snezhnaya ) is an upcoming playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact . As the Tsaritsa and Cryo Archon , Anastasya rules Snezhnaya as a cold but benevolent figure, having declared war against the Heavenly Principles for the transgressions they committed against the people of Teyvat .

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Danica Postelnitskaya ( Russian : Даника Постельницкая Danica Postelnitskaya ) is an upcoming playable Electro character in Genshin Impact . Head housemaid of the Snezhnayan royal house, she is considered the Tsaritsa 's right hand and is often by her side, along with the Commander of the Druzhna , Vesna . [ 6 ]

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Focalors —also known as the Regina of All Waters, Kindreds, Peoples and Laws —was the last God of Justice and Hydro Archon of The Seven , who presided over Fontaine after the cataclysm for 499 [ 7 ] years until her death. Prior to her ascension, she was originally one of Egeria 's Oceanid familiars that were turned into human by her hand. She succeeded Egeria following the latter's death during the cataclysm 500 years ago. Upon her…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: My ideals have no stains. I must correct you. People here bear no sins in the eyes of the gods... Only laws and the Tribunal can judge someone. They can judge even me. So praise my magnificence and purity.

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Focalors is a fair-skinned woman with heterochromic eyes, her right eye being light blue and her left eye dark blue. Like Furina, her hair is of a whitish-blue tinge with light blue streaks, and is divided into two parts: a short bell-shaped bob that goes to her neck, and two longer strands of hair that go down to her waist. She also has beaded-like eyelashes just like Furina. Focalors wears a white dress with puffy long sleeves and…

chapters.title: Personality
chapters.text: As Focalors and Furina are two aspects of a once singular being, their personality and interests are similar. She shares Furina's passion for drama and her fascination with grand displays of human emotion, but does not display Furina's emotionality, as those stem from the humanity that now resides entirely within Furina. Due to her lack of humanity, Focalors has a rather blunt way of speaking, as seen by her nonchalance when revealing that she cursed Furina or the…

chapters.title: History
chapters.text: Focalors was originally an Oceanid who was later illegitimately bestowed with humanity by the previous Hydro Archon, the goddess Egeria , using the powers of the Primordial Sea . This act of creating a new species of humanity without permission angered the Heavenly Principles , who responded by setting in motion the ominous prophecy of Fontaine. Egeria would later perish during the cataclysm , [ 8 ] and Focalors was instated in her place as the new Hydro…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Noy ( Russian : Ной Noy ) is a character in Genshin Impact . He is an ancient Snowland Fae from a distant era. [ 5 ] He makes his first appearance during Transcendence Trailer - "Sudden Snow."

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Noy is a Fae lord who once lived in the time of Hyperborea and called that now-destroyed civilization his home. Noy was beyond the starry sky when Hyperborea was destroyed. He was acquainted with the Belyi Tsar Monomakh Snezhnyi, [ 6 ] who granted him the title of Tysyatsky [ 7 ] and hoped Noy would aid his successor, the Tsaritsa Anastasya . Noy lives at his castle of Protakropolis . [ 6 ]

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Pantalone , also known as " Regrator " and by his personal name Feofan Sergeyevich Veksel ( Russian : Феофан Сергеевич Вексель Feofan Sergeyevich Veksel' ), is the Ninth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers and the president of Northland Bank . He is in charge of the financial affairs of Snezhnaya and his economic interventions have far-reaching effects throughout Teyvat . His ultimate goal is to seize control over the economy of the continent and end the financial…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Pantalone was born into poverty and was never able to receive a Vision , leading him to foster in resentment for the gods and their control over resources like Mora . [ 7 ] Rex Lapis in particular appears to be the greatest target of Pantalone's ire, [ 7 ] [ 8 ] as he is the sole source of Mora and as a result, Teyvat 's economy is effectively under his control. [ 9 ] This instilled…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: While Pantalone's chronological age is at least 400 years, he retained the physical appearance of a 45-year-old man as a result of Dottore's Elixir of Immortality. [ Note 1 ] He has curly black hair that reaches to his shoulders and ends in a dark purple ombre. In A Winter Night's Lazzo , Pantalone wears a typical Snezhnayan coat of white color with black fur on the hoods and sleeves. In game, he instead wears a black coat…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: Pulcinella , also known as " The Rooster " and by his personal name Mirko Radovidovich Veleshek , is the Fifth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers , Mayor of Snezhnograd as well as Glupov , and Speaker of the Snezhnograd Veche . He is a long-lived Domovoy who has served Snezhnaya as a politician for centuries and holds great influence over the domestic affairs of the nation. He is currently one of the major organizers for Project Stuzha…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: Pulcinella, "The Rooster," is the Fifth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers . [ 5 ] [ 6 ] He is the Mayor of Snezhnograd and the Speaker of the Snezhnograd Veche . [ 7 ] [ 6 ] Pulcinella inducted Tartaglia into the Fatui, [ 8 ] who worked his way up into the Harbingers, unlike several other Harbingers who were hand-picked for the position by Pierro . According to Arlecchino , he is an "exceptional" mayor, being…

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Pulcinella is a white-haired elderly man with white mustache and rounded glasses along with pointy nose and ears. He wears a dark blue longcoat with flared and feathered sleeves over at least a pair of baggy blue trousers and long flared shoes. His coat has a wide feathered collar with some form of hat or headdress with a pair of feathers. Though a Domovoy and thus naturally short, Pulcinella is actually considered tall for his people, about a…

chapters.title: Story
chapters.text: Mirko Radovidovich Veleshek is a long-lived Domovoy who has lived for centuries. Shortly after the cataclysm 500 years ago, he entered the human world to secure a place for himself in the world Anastasya was planning to make. He joined the Fatui and was immediately appointed into a Harbinger, being granted the codenames "Pulcinella" and "The Rooster," but was nonetheless made into the protégé of I. Ivanovna N. , the Mayor of Snezhnograd at the time, from whom…

chapters.title: Notice du personnage
chapters.text: La Signora , also known as " The Fair Lady " and by her personal name Rosalyne-Kruzchka Lohefalter , was the Eighth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers . A woman from Mondstadt , she was in a romantic relationship with Rostam , but became severely embittered when he died during the Cataclysm 500 years ago. Her grief drove her to hunt monsters, which earned her the infamous moniker as the Crimson Witch of Flame, until she was eventually…

chapters.title: Profile
chapters.text: As the Eighth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, Signora possessed great power, both in combat and in diplomatic relations. [ 2 ] Signora wielded a Cryo Delusion, [ 1 ] and could also use fire-based powers. [ 9 ]

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Signora was a tall and slim woman with pale skin, platinum-blond hair, and grey eyes. Some of her hair was tied into two rose-shaped buns at the back of her head. She wore a black earring on her left ear and a black mask that covered her right eye. She was seen with what appears to be a Catalyst hovering behind her right shoulder, which presumably was her Cryo Delusion.

chapters.title: Character Details
chapters.text: Beyond the familiar stars gracing the stage, there is always an eye-catching spectator in the audience. Sporting an unmistakable hairstyle, a lively scarf draped over his shoulders, and a notebook clutched in hand, he can also sometimes be found fleeing the scene, a towering, stern-faced officer hot on his heels. His conspicuous, comical antics easily rival those of an obscure performance artist, while his close ties to the troupe's two lead performers make him look like one of…

chapters.title: Character Story 1
chapters.text: His good fortune began in Teplo Oasis, where sweeping fields, pastoral scenery, and simple, honest folk rarely found in this frozen realm freely nourished the little beetroot. In his memory, the rolling wheat was a golden expanse made for running wild, and welcoming peddlers were always arriving with curious treats. Madame Sezhna's juices and pastries smelled richly of honey, while his father's study, piled high with blueprints, became an everyday playground under Mitya's own "diligent research." The world…

chapters.title: Character Story 2
chapters.text: Wisdom is oil-soaked kindling that takes only a single spark to burst into furious flame. And the Armory Palace, where the brightest minds in Snezhnaya gathered, was an ammunition depot, waiting only for the firing pin meant for it. The one who detonated this "depot" was not some eminent scientific giant. He was just an ordinary specialist whom the Energy Commission couldn't wait to ship off just to buy some peace and quiet. And yet, he had unwittingly…

chapters.title: Character Story 3
chapters.text: "Hey, Mitya! Those days are over. No more running off to fool around whenever you feel like it! Now hand over that escape formula!" According to Mitya's notes, that seemed to be his very first impression of Valeriy. As it turned out, while this account was riddled with bias, the escape formula itself was undeniably real, governed by several criteria: First, an escape needed dense crowds to throw off pursuit, which made a bustling central train station the…

chapters.title: Character Story 4
chapters.text: Mitya was a rather unusual young man, the sort who never failed to leave quite an impression on those around him. It was he who sparked the Energy Commission's desperate craving for peace and quiet. It was he who showed Valeriy just how much earnest dedication and ingenuity a brilliant researcher could pour into dodging check-ins. And this time, Snezhnaya's Prima Donna was about to experience the lecture known as "Mitya." Picture this: For a celebrated singer who…

chapters.title: Character Story 5
chapters.text: A single sheet of stationery lay quietly on Mitya's desk. It was the opening to the first, and only will he had ever drafted. After coming face-to-face with "death," he had dug out this unfinished draft and placed it squarely in the center of his workspace. Clearly, its author intended to seize what impressions of death still lingered, leaving behind a truly rigorous, practical official template for those who would follow. "My scarf and I are both doing…

chapters.title: Personality
chapters.text: Commander of the Special Assignments Battalion. A soldier skilled at protecting key personnel and keeping operations on track.

chapters.title: Appearance
chapters.text: Valeriy uses the tall male model. He has pale skin, short black hair, and purple eyes that alternate between light and dark rings.

chapters.title: Character Details
chapters.text: The Fatui , a symbol of Snezhnaya 's might, a formidable army that protects its citizens... Professional, efficient, calm, decisive... So many words have been used to praise them. Whenever the soldiers and Landcruisers parade through the square, they are greeted with thunderous cheers and blessings. To enlist, to be tested time and again, and to become a Fatui soldier as tough as steel... For many children in Snezhnaya, this is the dream of a lifetime. But reality…

chapters.title: Character Story 1
chapters.text: Long ago, in the land of snow. The newly crowned Tsaritsa Anastasya faced rebellion from many among the fae nobility. Unlike Emperor Monomakh before her, she did not muster the Druzhna . Instead, she raised a new force known as the Fatui to fight the rebels. Under the Tsaritsa's banner, the Fatui achieved one victory after another, seizing the lands of many clans and swiftly routing the old armies of lords and nobles. Their glorious triumphs were too…

chapters.title: Character Story 2
chapters.text: "Fortress Bear" might sound rather endearing at first, but it could be a compliment or a mockery. The name originated from Valeriy's days at the Royal Military Academy . Back then, noble and wealthy merchant families often sent their children into the military to polish their resume. As the saying went, "Toss a snowball at the Royal Military Academy's library, and you'd offend five future dignitaries." And unlike the easygoing atmosphere of ordinary schools, the academy placed particular…

chapters.title: Character Story 3
chapters.text: Not a drop of a comrade's blood should be shed needlessly. As for the enemy's, the more, the better. After joining the First Battalion's assault company in the Grenadier Guards First Regiment, Valeriy received his first assignment: to march east with the company and wipe out the rebels entrenched outside Teplo Oasis, who sought to restore the rule of the lords of old... The rebel leader's family seemed to have fallen under some strange influence. For generations, they…

chapters.title: Character Story 4
chapters.text: During the operation against the Skoldyryt rebels, Company Commander Arakcheyev had remained passive, failing to take the initiative. Yet in his subsequent report written to shift the blame, he attributed the operation's setbacks primarily to "inadequate preliminary reconnaissance"... Anyone with eyes could see that reconnaissance fell squarely within the company commander's responsibilities. Unfortunately, the statistics alone painted a splendid picture. The company's performance could even be held up as a model for others to follow. In the end,…

chapters.title: Character Story 5
chapters.text: During his time as an assault company commander, Valeriy had begun to show his mettle, proving his ability to lead elite troops through a string of glorious victories. In the Special Assignments Battalion's first year, his steady operations on both fronts had shown that he could be relied upon to restore discipline among regular units and counter unconventional threats. The requirements had been met, and the time has come... Within the Armory Palace in Glupov, a top-secret research…

chapters.title: Vision
chapters.text: Grand ambitions aren't always what set a "hero" on their path. Sometimes, giving one's all for the people close to them is enough to bring the right person onto the right stage. Everything that follows depends on whether they can seize that chance... Valeriy never considered himself worthy of the word "hero," yet the world seemed to have recognized him as one, in its own ambiguous way. Valeriy's decision to enlist wasn't driven by any grand ideals. Money…

mondstadt.title: Le littoral au-delà de la cité
mondstadt.text: Le récit de Mondstadt se prolonge vers le nord, où l’arrivée au port de Dornman fait découvrir un autre versant de la région. Les fleurs de Milhaven et l’ancien établissement de soins, que des rumeurs disent hanté, donnent au parcours des points d’ancrage très différents de ceux du prologue autour de la cité et de Dvalin.

mondstadt.title: De la fête des Alizées aux vendanges
mondstadt.text: Les deux fêtes éclairent des aspects différents de la communauté. Le festival des Alizées suit les usages liés aux fleurs et à leur offrande. Les vendanges se concentrent sur la mémoire familiale de Razor, qui reconstitue sa propre recette avec l’aide de ses proches.

liyue.title: Ce que les lanternes commémorent
liyue.text: Le Festival des Lanternes associe les rites de protection aux célébrations du port. Xiao intervient de son côté contre les vestiges des divinités vaincues, qui continuent d’agir après leur mort. Ce lien entre la fête publique et le travail invisible du Yaksha explique la place de Xiao dans le récit du festival.

inazuma.title: Du Shogunat à Watatsumi
inazuma.text: Les fiches officielles décrivent plusieurs pôles de pouvoir. Kujou Sara est générale de la commission Tenryou et fidèle à la Shogun. Les Kamisato sont liés à la commission Yashiro. À Watatsumi, Kokomi dirige l’île et Gorou commande ses troupes. Ces rôles situent les personnages de part et d’autre du conflit sur les Visions.

sumeru.title: Description
sumeru.text: Sumeru's landscape features both deserts [ 1 ] and forests. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] In Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview: Travail , Dainsleif likens it to a desert, and Liben mentions that "Sumeru is all rainforest and desert." During the cataclysm 500 years ago, the previous Dendro Archon and God of Wisdom, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata , was slain [ 4 ] and Lesser Lord…

fontaine.title: Description
fontaine.text: Of the regions of Teyvat, Fontaine prides itself as the hub of culture and the arts; or in the words of Francis , a traveling merchant from the region, "true beauty and elegance." The newspaper The Steambird is the main newspaper of the Court of Fontaine ; Mona is a columnist on it, suggesting that they have writers from all across Teyvat. According to the…

natlan.title: Description
natlan.text: Natlan is located beyond the west side of Sumeru 's desert region, the Great Red Sand , from the Desert of Hadramaveth . It is also home to natural hot springs created from volcanic activity. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Its people are grouped into six tribes, all of whom are united behind the Pyro Archon against the Abyss . People in Natlan live…

nod-krai.title: Description
nod-krai.text: Nod-Krai was formed from remnant material that was left over after the creation of the Three Moons . [ 8 ] It is especially hostile due to the harsh environment and lack of protective and regulative forces aside from the Voynich Guild , and Liben warns the Traveler to be wary if they go there. Those that are suspected to hold a large amount of…

snezhnaya.title: Description
snezhnaya.text: Snezhnaya is a region of perpetual winter storms; Nadia states that blizzards can last for a month straight and despite being in the midst of danger, its people look up to the sky and are just happy to be alive. Tartaglia claims that people would literally freeze to death if they didn't keep moving outside. At night, the Snezhnayan sky can see a beautiful aurora…

khaenriah.title: Description
khaenriah.text: In the perpetual meantime of a sheltered eternity, most are content to live, and not to dream. But in the hidden corners where the gods' gaze does not fall, there are those who dream of dreaming. Some say a few are chosen and the rest are dregs, but I say we humans have our humanity. We will defy this world with a power from beyond.…

khaenriah.title: Art of Khemia
khaenriah.text: Khaenri'ah was an underground realm, and its natural fauna were few indeed. As such, its alchemy focused more heavily on the creation of life. This art of creation was known as "The Art of Khemia." The Art of Khemia is an advanced type of alchemy developed in Khaenri'ah which allows for the creation of life itself. [ 18 ] It was very popular during the…

khaenriah.title: Eclipse Dynasty
khaenriah.text: The Khaenri'ahns are descendants of Anastasya and Saarelainen . [ 24 ] Pure-blooded Khaenri'ahns constitute a separate biology from other human populations of Teyvat as the curse of the wilderness does not affect them; only Khaenri'ahns descended from surface humans can turn into hilichurls . [ 25 ] People with a strong Khaenri'ahn bloodline can be easily identified by their eyes. The general population have…

celestia.title: Le siège céleste et les pouvoirs divins
celestia.text: Celestia est associée au pouvoir céleste de Teyvat. Pour suivre ce fil, l’histoire de Fontaine permet de distinguer la Gnosis, le trône d’Archon et le rôle public joué par Furina. Cette distinction aide à lire le projet de Focalors et ses conséquences pour le pouvoir Hydro.

abyss.title: Ancient History
abyss.text: The Abyss has existed in the sea of stars since long before the earliest known history of Teyvat. At an unknown point in time, it destroyed the alien civilization of Throgg . When Anacharsis visited Teyvat to speak with Dragon King Nibelung , she informed him that the planet would one day be destroyed by the Abyss. [ 24 ] In response, Nibelung encouraged his…

abyss.title: The Cataclysm
abyss.text: At some point, five prominent individuals from Khaenri'ah; Surtalogi , Rhinedottir , Vedrfolnir , Hroptatyr and Rerir became tempted by the call of the Abyss and discovered a massive source of power from it that could destroy Teyvat. They shared it among themselves, becoming the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah , but also transcendent beings with "world-shattering" power. [ 35 ] Five hundred years ago, during…

events.title: Fête des Alizées
events.summary: Les habitants offrent des fleurs et participent aux jeux du festival. Le récit suit notamment Bennett, Razor et Venti autour des traditions de Mondstadt.

events.title: Le souffle des Alizées
events.summary: Collei revient à Mondstadt avec Tighnari et Cyno. Une prophétie les pousse à parcourir la ville et à interroger leurs amis.

events.title: Ballades et breuvages
events.summary: La Fête des vendanges ramène Razor vers les souvenirs de ses parents. Les habitants l’aident à composer son vin du vent.

events.title: Poésie des eaux
events.summary: Une rencontre poétique réunit des invités de Mondstadt et de Liyue. Les échanges éclairent l’histoire de Callirhoe et d’un ancien amour.

events.title: Ombres au milieu des tempêtes de neige
events.summary: Les aventures aux Monts Dosdragon confrontent le groupe à un mystère autour d’Albedo et de son origine.

events.title: Le prince de craie et le dragon
events.originalTitle: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon
events.summary: Albedo demande au Voyageur d’étudier une épée venue des Monts Dosdragon. L’expédition relie l’arme à l’histoire de Durin.

events.title: Forteresse féline
events.summary: À Mondstadt, le Voyageur aménage des espaces pour les chats et apprend à gagner leur confiance.

events.title: Festival des Lanternes
events.summary: Liyue prépare les lanternes célestes et commémore ses héros. Le récit invite Xiao à prendre part aux festivités à sa manière.

events.title: Couleurs éphémères en vol
events.summary: Le port célèbre un nouveau Festival des Lanternes. Les préparatifs s’accompagnent d’un retour sur la Chambre de Jade et sur le quotidien de Keqing.

events.title: Les carillons de la nuit
events.summary: Le festival s’organise autour d’un concert. L’enquête musicale fait remonter des souvenirs des Adeptes et de leur entourage.

events.title: Cerfs-volants dans la brise du printemps
events.originalTitle: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze
events.summary: Les cerfs-volants animent la fête. Le récit suit Gaming et les tensions familiales qui entourent sa passion pour la danse wushou.

events.title: Réjouissances au clair de lune
events.summary: Xiangling participe au concours de cuisine du festival. Le récit remonte aux traditions culinaires de Liyue et à l’histoire de Guoba.

events.title: Étude de potions
events.summary: Timaeus rejoint Ying’er à Liyue pour mettre ses potions à l’épreuve. L’événement relie la recherche alchimique aux savoir-faire locaux.

events.title: Recevoir des amis venus de loin
events.summary: Le Voyageur prépare des plats à l’Auberge Wangshu. Chaque service est l’occasion de retrouver des visiteurs de plusieurs nations.

events.title: Sentier périlleux
events.summary: Une expédition dans le Gouffre réunit Yelan, Yanfei, Itto, Shinobu et Xiao. L’exploration retrace le destin d’un Yaksha et révèle une histoire liée aux anciennes troupes de Liyue.

events.title: Une aventure boueuse et bizarre
events.summary: Le chercheur Hosseini étudie une boue noire dans le Gouffre. Le Voyageur défend son équipement contre les monstres qui perturbent ses mesures.

events.title: Teintes du jardin violet
events.summary: Le festival Irodori accueille des écrivains et artistes venus de plusieurs nations. Une enquête reconstitue l’histoire des Cinq Kasen.

events.title: Akitsu Kimodameshi
events.summary: Une épreuve de courage organisée à Inazuma conduit le Voyageur sur les traces d’une ancienne amitié entre humains et yōkai.

events.title: Offrande d’accès aux Trois Royaumes
events.summary: Une obscurité recouvre Enkanomiya. L’exploration met en jeu les récits de Watatsumi, la lumière de la boîte de Bokuso et des vestiges souterrains.

events.title: Guerriers du labyrinthe
events.summary: Shiki Taishou accompagne le Voyageur, Xinyan et Tartaglia dans un domaine inazumien. L’exploration fait resurgir des fragments de sa mémoire.

events.title: Hors du cadre, dans l’objectif
events.originalTitle: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens
events.summary: Asagiri confie au Voyageur des sujets à photographier. Les paysages servent de références à son travail d’illustratrice.

events.title: Esprit guerrier
events.summary: Un tournoi de sabre rassemble des combattants à Inazuma. Ayaka participe à la cérémonie liée à l’épreuve.

events.title: Le grand festival de tambour d’Arataki
events.originalTitle: The Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival
events.summary: La bande d’Arataki invite le Voyageur à un festival musical. Les morceaux sont joués au tambour sur l’île d’Amakane.

events.title: Camp d’entraînement aux combats de scarabées d’Arataki
events.originalTitle: Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp
events.summary: Itto et le Voyageur retrouvent les amateurs de combats d’onikabutos. La préparation et les duels forment le cœur de l’événement.

events.title: Hyakunin Ikki
events.summary: Inazuma accueille une épreuve de combat où de petites équipes se relaient. La notice suit les différentes éditions du tournoi.

events.title: Parade de la providence
events.summary: Le festival de l’Académie rassemble ses six Darshans. La compétition révèle aussi l’histoire du diadème de la connaissance et des motivations de plusieurs candidats.

events.title: Frénésie des fongus
events.summary: Un tournoi met en scène des équipes de fongus apprivoisés. Layla et Yae Miko se joignent à l’événement.

events.title: Ode aux bonbons et aux roses
events.originalTitle: Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses
events.summary: Les habitants préparent une célébration pour Nahida à l’occasion du festival Sabzeruz. Le récit revient sur les liens qu’elle a tissés avec Sumeru.

events.title: Paradis estival secret
events.summary: Une excursion conduit Klee et ses amis au Mirage de Veluriyam, accessible depuis Sumeru. Le groupe découvre le monde abrité dans la bouteille d’Idyia.

events.title: Innocence sculptée
events.summary: L’atelier Acara cherche de nouvelles idées pour ses sculptures. Le Voyageur explore la forêt et observe les animaux et les plantes de Sumeru.

events.title: Analyse des comprimés
events.summary: La chercheuse Hajanad demande au Voyageur de tester des effets expérimentaux en combat. L’événement présente une application des travaux menés à Sumeru.

events.title: Tempête de sable fulminante
events.summary: Des chercheurs testent un canon dans le désert de Sumeru. Le Voyageur protège les installations et assiste l’équipe confrontée aux Wenuts.

events.title: Roses et mousquets
events.summary: Le festival Fontinalia accueille un tournage réunissant des invités d’Inazuma et des artistes de Fontaine. L’intrigue du film croise une enquête de Chevreuse.

events.title: Les aventures fantastiques de Thelxie
events.summary: Freminet et le Voyageur participent à une aventure autour d’un pingouin mécanique. Le récit relie l’imaginaire marin à une histoire familiale.

events.title: Mêlée méga méka
events.summary: Dans un atelier de la Cour de Fontaine, des défis inspirés des Mékas rythment l’événement. Le Voyageur aide l’atelier à préparer ses jouets.

events.title: Études de lumière et d’ombre à Fontaine
events.originalTitle: Studies in Light and Shadow: A Fontaine of Enchantment
events.summary: Le Voyageur photographie les espèces et les lieux de Fontaine pour Bresson. Le parcours mêle observations sous-marines et paysages de surface.

events.title: Journal d’expérimentation de technologie graphique
events.summary: Lepine-Pauline fait appel au Voyageur pour rassembler des échantillons photographiques. Le journal éclaire une expérience menée à Fontaine.

events.title: Simulation de renforcement de la sécurité mutuelle
events.summary: Le Voyageur participe à un exercice tactique organisé à Fontaine. Des unités sont déployées dans des scénarios de simulation.

events.title: Journal d’écriture réflexive
events.summary: Le Voyageur participe à des épreuves associant imagination et collecte de pièces. L’événement est présenté par un scénariste à Fontaine.

events.title: Parchemins des esprits Iktomi
events.summary: Le Voyageur accompagne Citlali et Ororon dans une enquête. Les pratiques du Maître du Vent nocturne occupent une place centrale.

events.title: Tournoi de la gloire florissante
events.summary: Les épreuves de Natlan rassemblent des participants autour de leurs traditions de compétition et de coopération.

events.title: Station estivale de Sunspray
events.summary: Le Voyageur rejoint des personnages de Natlan dans une station de vacances. L’événement fait aussi connaître Aino et Ineffa.

events.title: Traces d’art
events.summary: Le Voyageur rencontre des artisans et collecte des impressions dans Natlan. Les épreuves accompagnent la découverte de la région.

events.title: L’arc-en-ciel destiné à brûler
events.summary: Ce chapitre de la quête principale suit l’affrontement entre Natlan et l’Abîme. Il replace les héros des tribus et l’Ode à la Résurrection dans le récit.

events.title: Ode incandescente à la résurrection
events.summary: Le Voyageur et Mavuika se préparent à affronter la menace de l’Abîme. Cette quête principale conclut une étape de la guerre de Natlan.

events.title: Clink Clank Clash
events.summary: Un événement de Nod-Krai centré sur les inventions d’Aino. Le dossier conserve le lien vers la notice de l’événement et ses quêtes.

events.title: Une danse de marées neigeuses et de bosquets givrés
events.originalTitle: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
events.summary: Le premier acte de l’arc de Nod-Krai présente ses habitants et les enjeux autour des lunes. Il s’agit d’une quête principale, distincte des événements temporaires.

events.title: Everwinter Without Mercy
events.summary: Ce chapitre introduit Snezhnaya et ouvre son récit principal. La notice permet de retrouver le contexte des personnages et des institutions de la région.

events.title: Un requiem pour le monde souterrain
events.summary: Ce chapitre poursuit l’histoire de Snezhnaya. Les dialogues et sous-quêtes sont consultables dans la source.

events.title: Hour of Ruin
events.summary: Cette étape de l’histoire de Snezhnaya comprend notamment les sous-quêtes Like Melting Snow et A Step Toward the Future.

events.title: Étoiles qui ne s’accordent pas
events.summary: Une pluie de météorites affecte des habitants de Mondstadt et de Liyue. L’enquête réunit Fischl, Mona et le Voyageur.

events.title: Aventure d’une île d’été
events.summary: Klee reçoit une invitation du roi Dodo. L’expédition découvre l’archipel de la Pomme dorée et les installations préparées par Alice.

events.title: Odyssée estivale
events.summary: L’archipel de la Pomme dorée revient. Des domaines inspirés des souvenirs de Kazuha, Xinyan, Fischl et Mona structurent l’aventure.

events.title: Écailles et contes d’été
events.summary: Le Voyageur explore le monde de Simulanka avec Nilou, Kirara et leurs compagnons. Le récit suit l’histoire d’un dragon et la façon dont ce monde l’a écrite.
